meta.name: technical-analyst
meta.description: This skill should be used when analyzing weekly price charts for Indian stocks (NSE/BSE), indices (Nifty 50, Bank Nifty, Sensex), or any other instrument. Use this skill when the user provides chart images and requests technical analysis, trend identification, support/resistance levels, scenario planning, or probability assessments based purely on chart data without consideration of news or fundamental factors.

copy.tagline: 分析印度股票图表，识别趋势与支撑阻力位
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常看印度股市K线图做技术分析
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Indian stock charts to identify trends and support/resistance levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly analyze Indian stock charts for technical trading

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你提供的印度股票或指数的周线图，识别趋势、支撑阻力位、均线关系和成交量模式，并给出未来价格走势的概率场景。
howto.when: 当你上传周线图并请求技术分析、趋势识别、支撑阻力位或概率评估时触发。

say.text: 请分析这张 Nifty 50 周线图。
say.note: Claude 会按流程分析并生成报告。

say.text: 帮我看看 Reliance 的支撑和阻力位。
say.note: Claude 会重点标注关键价格水平。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude analyzes weekly price charts of Indian stocks or indices, identifies trends, support/resistance, moving averages, and volume patterns, then produces probabilistic scenarios for future price movement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload a weekly chart image and request technical analysis, trend identification, support/resistance levels, or probability assessment.

say_en.text: Analyze this weekly chart of Nifty 50.
say_en.note: Claude will perform full analysis and generate a report.

say_en.text: Identify support and resistance for Reliance.
say_en.note: Claude will highlight key price levels.
